name: capital-stack-finterminal-web
description: Capital-Stack-FinTerminal web (#1351, design 3.5): the FinTerm pages of the SvelteKit webapps site served as static files behind the shared c3-pvt gate (Authelia 2FA session or fleet bearer) at c3-pvt.diegonmarcos.com/capital-stack-finterminal-web/. Same origin as c3-pvt.diegonmarcos.com/capital-stack-finterminal-api, so the page reads the /v1 API with the gate's session: no CORS, no token in the page. Built by cloudy-h-webapps-mob (ghcr.io/diegonmarcos/capital-stack-finterminal-web).

deploy._host_doc: oci-apps, beside capital-stack-finterminal-api: reached at capital-stack-finterminal-web.mesh.diegonmarcos.com over wg0, and publicly only at c3-pvt.diegonmarcos.com/capital-stack-finterminal-web behind the shared gate (#1104). No per-app public host.

runtime_extra_run: set -e; apk add --no-cache --virtual .fetch curl tar; mkdir -p /tmp/w; curl -fsSL https://codeload.github.com/diegonmarcos/cloudy-h-webapps-mob/tar.gz/df55fd534ccb694f766874395686bd84de1a5d63 | tar -xz -C /tmp/w --strip-components=4 --wildcards '*/sites/cloudy-webapps/dist/_app/*' '*/sites/cloudy-webapps/dist/capital-stack-finterminal/*'; cp -r /tmp/w/_app /tmp/w/capital-stack-finterminal /usr/share/nginx/html/; rm -rf /tmp/w; apk del .fetch

finterm._doc: The page base path is the c3-pvt route of this container (/capital-stack-finterminal-web); the API it reads same-origin is the c3-pvt route of the api container. The image ships the FinTerm pages of cloudy-h-webapps-mob's committed SvelteKit output (sites/cloudy-webapps/dist: _app + capital-stack-finterminal/) at the pinned commit webapps_ref, rebased at image build from /cloud-webapps to base_path, with the mesh API base replaced by the same-origin route /<api_container> (the gate's session, no CORS, no token). A symlink base_path -> . serves the same tree on the mesh name. Bump webapps_ref to ship a newer FinTerm web build.
